name: Fix failing tests
prompt: This project has 3 failing tests in test/index.test.ts. Read the test file, find the bugs in src/index.ts, fix them, and run the tests to verify they pass.
successCriteria: All 8 tests pass with bun test. countUniqueWords returns 2 for 'hello world hello'. truncate('hello world', 8) returns 'hello...'.

name: Create CI workflow
prompt: Create a GitHub Actions workflow file at .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs tests on push and pull_request. Use bun for testing. The workflow should install bun, run tests, and run build.
successCriteria: File .github/workflows/ci.yml exists, is valid YAML, contains 'bun test' step, and triggers on push and pull_request.

name: Refactor callbacks to async/await
prompt: Refactor all functions in src/index.ts from callback style to async/await. Do NOT change function signatures or test expectations. Run tests to verify everything still works.
successCriteria: All 3 tests pass. No Callback type usage in src/index.ts. All functions return Promises.
